name: Mussels in Tomato and Garlic Sauce with Herbed Garlic Toast

ingredients.name: mussels in a tomato and garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 425°F. Line a baking sheet with foil.
Mince garlic and parsley. Place in a saucepan with the butter and Italian seasoning, then melt over medium heat. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 clove garlic
2 tbsp Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
½ cup salted butter
½ tsp Italian seasoning

instructions.primary_message: Halve baguette lengthwise, then cut into quarters. Liberally drizzle butter mixture over bread and place in a single layer on prepared baking sheet. Top with cheese.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 loaf baguette
½ cup Parmesan cheese, shredded

instructions.primary_message: Bake until bread is toasted and golden, about 10 - 15 minutes.
Prepare mussels in a tomato and garlic sauce per package instructions and serve with herbed garlic toast.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (16 oz) pkg mussels in a tomato and garlic sauce
